subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should maintainers require a maintainer-run macOS LaunchAgent reproduction before changing Claude CLI auth/MCP runtime behavior for this managed-only 401 report?
rationale: The source path matches the reporter's detailed trace, but the failing condition depends on live Claude CLI OAuth, launchd service context, loopback MCP, and local credential state that this read-only review could not safely reproduce.

options.title: Require service-context proof
options.body: Run a controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison across gateway cron/channel execution, same-service Claude CLI replay, live MCP, empty MCP, and redacted credential state before changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Patch from reporter trace
options.body: Sponsor a targeted Claude CLI backend/auth change from the wrapper trace while accepting higher risk around auth-env and MCP policy because the exact trigger is still unproven.

options.title: Limit to recovery-copy work
options.body: Treat this as part of the expired-token hint cluster only if live proof shows it is the same expired-token recovery failure rather than a distinct managed service-context problem.

recommendation.title: Require service-context proof
recommendation.body: Run a controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison across gateway cron/channel execution, same-service Claude CLI replay, live MCP, empty MCP, and redacted credential state before changing runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history makes vincentkoc the strongest current routing candidate for Claude CLI auth/runtime behavior and live Anthropic smoke selection.
